hero.tagline: a synthesizer, a sampler and a sequencer. one instrument, all black.
hero.title: OP–XY
hero.subtitle: portable synthesizer · sampler · sequencer

strip.specDesc: the whole instrument is a grid. one row of instruments, one row of steps, and a two-octave keyboard under your fingers. the display keeps everything in grayscale, so the red means one thing: record.

macro.body: solid machined unibody chassis, ultra-tactile keycaps, zero wobble.

sequencer.title: the sequencer.
sequencer.description: every step can carry its own velocity, timing, pitch and up to fourteen components. brain transposes the chord progression underneath, so a pattern keeps reinventing itself while you play.

ports.title: connect everything.
ports.subtitle: the right end is an i/o system. amps, headphones, a modular, a drum machine, your laptop, and the mic on the side records straight into a track.

items.name: power
items.desc: on · off. sixteen hours on a charge.

items.name: usb-c
items.desc: audio and midi, host and device, charging.

items.name: midi in
items.desc: 3.5 mm. clock and notes from outside.

items.name: multi out
items.desc: midi, cv/gate, sync and aux audio on one jack.

items.name: line out
items.desc: 3.5 mm stereo with headset mic support.

plate.title: the other side.
plate.subtitle: the exact footprint of the OP–1 field. an aluminium plate, four feet, two loop pads, and everything it is printed once.
